# Can Fabrika

> Indie game studio in Berlin, Germany, making mobile games (iOS and Android) in two lines: pixel-art tycoon/management games and party games played with friends on phones. Founded by Can, who also runs the Turkish YouTube channel "Kendi Kendime Hikayeler" (31K+ subscribers).

## Games
- [Hero Heaven Tycoon](https://www.canfabrika.com/#hero-heaven-tycoon): Pixel-art idle tycoon RPG. A busy hero town, heroes hunting monsters together, loot, raids and boss walls. For fans of Evil Hunter Tycoon and Kairosoft games. In development.
- [REZİL](https://www.canfabrika.com/#rezil): 18+ party card game for phones in the spirit of Cards Against Humanity. Room codes, bots, 10 natively written languages (incl. Turkish, German, English), country, expat and office decks. In development.
- [HeroHaven](https://www.canfabrika.com/#herohaven): Cozy cat-themed pixel-art town and dungeon manager. iPhone first. In development.
